title: Jammy Juicy Italian Pork Saltimbocca
description: A Mediterranean-inspired brunch dish featuring grilled pork, prosciutto, and wonton skin, served in a jammy and silky sauce. This Italian saltimbocca is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy weekend brunch.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat and season the pork tenderloin with salt and black pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together chopped sage, garlic, and lemon juice.
Brush the wonton skin sheets with olive oil and top each sheet with a slice of prosciutto and a spoonful of the sage mixture.
Wrap each pork tenderloin medallion with a wonton skin sheet, prosciutto side in, and secure with a toothpick if needed.
Grill the pork saltimbocca for 4-5 minutes per side, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the pork is cooking, reduce the chicken broth in a small saucepan over medium heat until it reaches a jammy consistency.
Remove the pork from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Serve the sliced pork saltimbocca with the jammy chicken broth sauce spooned over the top and garnished with shaved grana padano cheese.
Garnish with additional sage leaves and lemon wedges if desired.
